nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the Wavee.Tests xUnit v3 suite covering the core Wavee library, with folder map, crypto validation notes (ShannonCipher/AudioDecryptStream against librespot vectors), run commands, and project references.

nodes.name: Wavee.Tests.csproj
nodes.summary: .NET 10 xUnit v3 test project targeting net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0 with AnyCPU/x64/ARM64 platforms, referencing Wavee and Wavee.Controls.Lyrics, using FluentAssertions and Moq for the core library test suite.
nodes.languageNotes: OutputType=Exe is required by xUnit v3; project supports three platform targets (AnyCPU, x64, ARM64).
